title: Jobs of Tomorrow
text:
Many experts believe that the way we work will change greatly over the next decade. Artificial intelligence is already doing some tasks that people used to do by hand, such as sorting data and writing simple reports. Because of this, workers will need to learn new skills, especially in areas that require judgement and personal contact. Some people feel anxious about these changes, while others are excited by the new opportunities.

Schools and employers are responding to this challenge. Many colleges now offer short courses that teach digital skills to adults who want a new career. Some companies also provide training for their staff so that they can move into different roles. Advisers often tell young people to keep learning throughout their lives, because the job they choose today may look very different in ten years.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is artificial intelligence already doing?
options: Sorting data and writing simple reports

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do many colleges now offer?
options: Short courses that teach digital skills to adults

questions.text: What can be inferred about workers who keep learning new skills?
options: They are likely to be better prepared for changes at work.
They will never need to change jobs.
They are no longer needed by their employers.
They are usually unhappy with their careers.

questions.text: Why might some people feel anxious about the future of work?
options: Because the changes may make their current skills less useful.
Because schools have stopped teaching anything new.
Because technology is becoming less common.

paragraph_translations: Birçok uzman, önümüzdeki on yılda çalışma biçimlerimizin büyük ölçüde değişeceğine inanıyor. Yapay zekâ, insanların eskiden elle yaptığı bazı işleri, örneğin verileri sıralamayı ve basit raporlar yazmayı şimdiden yapıyor. Bu nedenle çalışanların, özellikle muhakeme ve kişisel temas gerektiren alanlarda yeni beceriler öğrenmesi gerekecek. Bazı insanlar bu değişikliklerden endişe duyarken, diğerleri yeni fırsatlarla heyecanlanıyor.

Okullar ve işverenler bu zorluğa yanıt veriyor. Birçok kolej, yeni bir kariyer isteyen yetişkinlere dijital becerileri öğreten kısa kurslar sunuyor. Bazı şirketler de çalışanlarının farklı görevlere geçebilmesi için eğitim veriyor. Danışmanlar genç insanlara, bugün seçtikleri mesleğin on yıl sonra çok farklı görünebileceği için hayat boyu öğrenmeye devam etmelerini sıklıkla öneriyor.
